\small
\begin{tabular}{p{0.36\textwidth}p{0.34\textwidth}p{0.15\textwidth}l}
\toprule
Rule & Evidence & Kind & Section \\
\midrule
Calibrate on an object the machine can measure whole (a segmented slate), not on corners a person clicks. & label-free 2.8\% vs labelled 2.9\% error vs tape (pool); corners lose 24\% of V-slate frames (reef) & designed experiment; retrospective & \S5, \S9 \\
Treat the calibration object as one of unknown size; its printed template and known size add nothing. & same corner labels, same length error with or without the template & designed experiment & \S5 \\
Shoot calibration frames over at least a 2$\times$ range of apparent size (near and far). & 98\% of fits within 0.05$^\circ$ at $\geq$ 2$\times$; median misses below 1.5$\times$ & designed experiment & \S5, \S7 \\
Fix the laser offset from the mount design, not per dive. & per-dive fit wanders about $\pm$1.5 mm, one failure at 129.5 mm; \todo{design $|O|$ from the mount CAD} & retrospective & \S5, \S6 \\
Find calibration frames with a classifier, not a person. & 166 of 167 slate dives, precision 99.9\% & retrospective & \S5, \S8 \\
Never score a model against labels it, or another model, pre-filled. & 87\% of pre-filled laser labels accepted unchanged & retrospective & \S3, \S8 \\
Skip human review where a prediction agrees with the dive's own laser line. & 89\% of detector pre-fills kept exactly; the rest go to another spot, not a nudge & deployment before/after & \S3, \S8 \\
Choose the laser colour with the detector and the labeller in the loop, not only the diver. & green: +11 pt dot misses, +1.8 s per label; red: more confident wrong points & retrospective & \S6, \S8 \\
Auto-accept only the stages whose pre-fills are right-or-wrong; keep a person on the stages they nudge. & laser dots: kept or moved $\sim$400 px; snout: nudged $\sim$10 px on 56\% of fish & deployment before/after & \S3, \S8 \\
Take at least two frames of every fish. & 71\% $\rightarrow$ 85\% of fish within 10\% with a second frame & retrospective & \S7, \S9 \\
Let the segmenter's own score gate measurement; extra dot or learned gates add nothing. & learned gate AUC no better than SAM's score; dot gates barely change lengths & retrospective & \S9 \\
Run every stage on a workflow engine, not by hand. & label-sync time roughly halved & deployment before/after & \S3 \\
Build mounts that hold the laser angle (aluminium for field units). & \todo{analysis 3f: needs per-camera floor dates} & pending & \S6 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
